🚨 Breaking Update on HMPV 🚨

Health Minister JP Nadda clarifies:

🔹 HMPV is not a new virus—first identified in 2001, circulating globally for years.
🔹 Spread peaks during winter & early spring months.
🔹 No surge in respiratory viruses

🚨 Breaking Update on HMPV 🚨

Health Minister JP Nadda clarifies:

🔹 HMPV is not a new virus—first identified in 2001, circulating globally for years.
🔹 Spread peaks during winter & early spring months.
🔹 No surge in respiratory viruses in India as per surveillance data.
